value.rationale: This resolves the complete integral homotopy type and affine automorphism homology character of the first exceptional 5-regular strongly regular graph (16,5,0,2) for the natural 3-path-free/two-independence construction. Unlike familiar graph ranks or ordinary Ind_1 computations, the exact S4 classification and translation-trivial, coordinate-sign action give topological and symmetry information neither supplied by tree/chordal theorems nor by prior graph-complex calculations. A narrowly defined natural graph invariant is motivated by a developing higher-independence theory and does not require an infinite-family extrapolation.
